questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Mileage information, such as distances to specific locations.

questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about motorist services. These include rest areas, food, gas stations, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks an HOV (high occupancy vehicle) lane. These lanes are for buses and cars with multiple passengers only.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign shows a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn about railroad crossings only. Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert drivers to upcoming hazards.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: Triangular signs mean yield. Slow down at the intersection. Be ready to stop if needed. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians go first before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will curve sharply to the right, then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid accidents and brake damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A T intersection is ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no slower than 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.

questions.correctAnswerText: Approach the upcoming curve at a speed of 35 mph or slower.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. A speed plaque on the sign shows the recommended speed for the upcoming curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange diamond-shaped signs mark construction and maintenance work areas. They help drivers and pedestrians navigate safely through these zones. Traffic fines may be doubled in areas with these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: A sharp right turn is ahead on the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs enforce traffic laws and must be obeyed. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted. Do not turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: A traffic signal is at the next intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals can be used instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is extended straight out, it signals a left turn or lane change to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: When you see this sign, slow down and let vehicles and pedestrians cross your path. Stop if needed before continuing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you that you are near or entering a school zone. Watch for children and follow all posted speed limits in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn of construction areas. Drive carefully and stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic first. Only complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange sign warns you that roadwork is ahead. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle means yield. Slow down to a safe speed for current conditions and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road ahead makes a sharp turn to the right. Slow down before reaching this extreme curve, just as you would at a sharp intersection turn.
